Free Online Calculators & Converters for Fast, Accurate Math

Calcoly provides clean, instantaneous, and privacy-first online calculation and conversion tools. Every calculation runs locally in your web browser with zero lag, zero tracking cookies, and no account registration required. Whether you are baking bread, checking construction dimensions, splitting a bill, or converting international units, Calcoly delivers verified results in milliseconds.

Unit Converters

Seamlessly convert between Metric, US Customary, and British Imperial measurement systems. Popular converters include our CM to Inches Converter and Inches to CM Converter for height and screen sizing, KG to LBS Converter and LBS to KG Converter for body weight and gym metrics, MM to Inches for precision machining, and Celsius to Fahrenheit and Fahrenheit to Celsius for weather and oven temperatures.

Calculators for Everyday Math

Handle essential everyday arithmetic and health equations without complex software. Solve percentage problems with our Percentage Calculator, calculate growth and salary adjustments using the Percentage Increase Calculator, or evaluate fitness benchmarks with the BMI Calculator and TDEE Calculator.

Baking & Cooking Converters

Culinary measurements require weight-to-volume precision because ingredient density varies dramatically. Use our Cups to Grams Converter and Grams to Cups Converter to accurately weigh 16 essential baking ingredients. Bread makers can fine-tune flour and water ratios with the Sourdough Hydration Calculator or multiply batch sizes using the Recipe Scaler.

Money & Finance Tools

Make fast personal finance decisions with transparent, no-fluff calculation tools. Calculate gratuity and split bills with the Tip Calculator, compute retail discounts with the Discount Calculator, calculate net and gross tax with the VAT Calculator, or project savings growth with the Step-Up Compound Interest Calculator.

Date & Time Tools

Track calendar durations and project timelines easily. Calculate calendar intervals with the Days Between Dates Calculator, find exact birth milestone durations with the Age Calculator, or eliminate international confusion between US (MM/DD/YYYY) and UK (DD/MM/YYYY) formats with the Date Format Resolver.

Everyday Utility Tools

Practical utility tools designed for makers, writers, and hobbyists. Count words, characters, and reading time with the Word Counter, match yarn plies with the Yarn Weight & Gauge Converter, calculate print resolutions with the Paper Size to Pixels Converter, or check tire pressure units using the PSI to BAR Pressure Converter.

Why Use Calcoly?

  • 100% Client-Side Speed & Privacy: All calculations execute in your browser via lightweight JavaScript. Your private numbers, weights, and measurements are never stored or transmitted to remote servers.
  • Zero Distractions: No popups, forced logins, subscription paywalls, or cluttered banner ads blocking your screen.
  • Verified Mathematical Accuracy: Built on international scientific conversion constants (NIST, ISO, and standard culinary densities).

Frequently Asked Questions

Are all calculators and converters on Calcoly completely free?
Yes. Every single tool, conversion chart, and printable cheat sheet on Calcoly is 100% free to use with no account registration or payment required.
Does Calcoly store the numbers or values I enter?
No. All calculations run strictly client-side inside your browser. Nothing you type is saved, tracked, or sent to our servers.
Are Calcoly tools mobile-friendly?
Yes. Every page is fully responsive, optimized with touch-friendly controls, fast loading speeds, and automatic iOS zoom prevention.
How accurate are the conversion formulas?
All converters use official international standard conversion constants (such as 1 inch = 2.54 cm and 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg) with full floating-point precision.
